Users (2 attrs): Color Change (16 attr 0, installed by the ER rebalance patcher in place of the vanilla after-hit version) and Prismatic Fur (5176 attr 0). blocks.packageReason: Package, justified in the header. Users (1 attr): Liquid Ooze (64 attr 0). The class dispatches BlockNonDirectDamageAbAttr on the attacker BEFORE it looks at the move, even for moves with no drain effect (the dispatch can show the attacker's ability flyout, kept as it was). `simulated` is passed through to that dispatch and apply returns early when simulated. Engine identity checks by attr name (HitHealAttr.apply in move.ts, Leech Seed in battler-tags.ts, the lifesteal archetype, common-root) keep working because the rebuilt instance is the same class. Honest bucket: package-only for the effect; the trigger is the shared 'After I am hit' block and extra IFs can be ANDed on top.
